ceu: ✦ The square between the Moon and Saturn at {H:1806423162000}

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.
The square between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between your career and your image. A short pause avoids a long argument.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Ask for an honest opinion from someone you respect.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.
The square between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between your horizons and your inner life. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Write down where you want to be a year from now.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.
The square between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between intimacy and friendships. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: End the day with a minute of gratitude for what has changed in you.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.
The square between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between relationships and your career. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to your partner or to a close friend.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.
The square between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between routine and your horizons. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Swap a snack for fruit and notice how you feel.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.
The square between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between romance and intimacy. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Dance at home, even if it is just to one song.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.
The square between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between family and relationships. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Open the windows in the morning and let fresh air into your home.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.
The square between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between conversations and routine. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
With Mars retrograde in your career sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Before reacting to a message, read it twice.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.
The square between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between money and romance. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Think of a way to make one of your talents pay off.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.
The square between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between your image and family. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
With Mars retrograde in your intimacy sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Start something new today, however small.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.
The square between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between your inner life and conversations. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
With Mars retrograde in your relationships sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Spend five minutes in silence before going to sleep.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.
The square between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between friendships and money. Hear both sides before you decide.
With Mars retrograde in your daily routine sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Write down a dream and three steps to get there.
